svg.desc: Water Supply Networks & GIS Systems LOCATION Al Baha, KSA CLIENT Ministry of Water and Electricity STATUS EST. VALUE In Progress 400 million SAR DISCIPLINES Architectural Design Structural / Civil Engineering Mechanical Engineering Electrical Engineering Project Overview This ongoing project in Al Baha covers the design of water and irrigation systems, including networks, pumping stations and reservoirs integrated with the city's GIS. BECT provides architectural, structural and MEP services, together with project management and site supervision, for the Ministry of Water and Electricity.
